summary: Iteration 17: tested CEF compatibility checks (POST /api/cef/check + live in CefEditor), manual SLD values editing (GET/PUT /api/sld/{id}/values + SldEditor UI), and PV PIF report (GET/PUT /api/dossier/{id}/pif + PDF + PifPanel UI). Backend pytest 18/18 pass. Frontend: all requested flows work individually (battery fields shown, incompatibility error live, editor save -> toast + manual badge + iframe reload, PIF save/reload). Found 2 HIGH data-loss bugs: stale ModulePage form overwrites SLD manual edits and PIF measurements on the next form save. Also API edge cases: 'inf'/'nan' accepted as numeric -> record becomes unreadable (500); non-dict bodies -> 500.

critical.issue: Does not pop 'pif' from payload. Frontend form holds the PIF loaded when the dossier was opened; after saving new PIF measurements in PifPanel, clicking main 'Salvează' (or any SldPanel persist: Salvează și verifică / Previzualizare / Aprobă) overwrites rec.pif with the stale copy -> entered measurements lost. Reproduced: saved string 0.1 Voc 490.5 via pif-save, clicked save-btn -> GET pif no longer has 0.1. Fix: data.pop('pif', None) in update_item for prosumator.

float('inf')/float('nan') accepted for numeric fields ('inf','nan','Infinity'). Stored in Mongo; afterwards GET /api/sld/{id}/values and GET /api/data/prosumator/{id} return 500 (non-JSON-compliant float) -> dossier cannot be opened. Fix: reject non-finite (math.isfinite) and probably negative values with 400.

minor.issue: Body {values:[...]} or non-JSON body -> 500 (list has no .items()); should be 400. Text fields accept arbitrary JSON (e.g. dict {a:1} stored as SPD AC value); coerce to str[:N]. Negative numbers (-5 A) accepted.
{strings:[...]} (list) -> 500; validate dict types. checks with invalid values silently dropped (OK).

When grounding_measured is empty the PDF prints the fișă/CEF grid.grounding_ohm (e.g. 3.2 Ω) under 'valoare măsurată, conform buletinului PRAM'. If grid.grounding_ohm is a design/configured value this contradicts 'measurements are never invented'; confirm the source is a PRAM-measured value or label it 'din fișă'. Operator falls back to company rep name when not entered (acceptable but note).

ui_bugs.issue: After applying manual SLD values, parent form.cef is not updated (onSaved only reloads /sld). The CEF configurator still shows old values (inv-0-ac-section stays 4 after setting 6) and the next persist (sld-refresh 'Salvează și verifică', main save-btn, preview, approve) PUTs stale cef -> manual values reverted AND removed from cef.manual. Reproduced: set spd_ac=T2, ac.section=6, saved (toast OK), clicked sld-refresh -> API shows spd_ac='tip 1+2' manual=false, section=4 manual=false; editor still displays T2/6 with 'manual' badge (UI out of sync). Fix: PUT /sld/{id}/values return updated cef and call setVal('cef', cef) in onSaved (SldPanel passes setVal).

Race: edits typed immediately after opening the editor can be wiped (load() resolves a second time -> setVals({})), observed when filling a number input right after the editor appears (likely StrictMode double effect). Minor; guard load or don't reset vals if a request is stale.

integration_issues.issue: PIF measurements lost on next main form save (see backend critical #1).

issues: pif-date uses native browser date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn calendar / ro-RO format
testids are inv-0-batvmin/batvmax/batimax (0-based with dash), not inv{N}-batvmin as described in the request — fine, just note for tests

HIGH: after PUT /sld/{id}/values, sync parent form.cef (return cef from PUT, setVal('cef', ...)) so later persists don't revert manual SLD edits / manual flags

LOW: return 400 for non-dict 'values'/'strings'/'inv'/'checks' payloads; coerce text values to strings; reject negative ratings
LOW: PIF PDF grounding fallback — label as 'din fișă' or leave empty unless measured

critical_code_review_comments: cef.check: battery voltage check only when both bat_v_min and bat_v_max present; bat_i_max/i_max comparisons and model warning work as specified.
cef.check: On-grid DC-battery check uses exact 'On-grid' but from_legacy sets type 'on-grid' (lowercase) — case mismatch; InverterCard also shows battery-range fields for legacy 'on-grid'.
sld_values_save: S.guard + check_access correct (limitat -> 403 verified for SLD values and PIF PUT).
pif_save does not verify cef exists; fine. pif_rows recomputes check() per call (OK).
SLD PDF reflects edited values (25 A and 'T2' found in PDF text).

success_rate.backend: 100% of requested pytest (18/18); 2 HIGH issues found via edge-case probes
success_rate.frontend: 85% (all requested flows pass in isolation; state-sync data loss bugs)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://dns-energy.preview.emergentagent.com pytest tests/test_iter17_cef_check_sld_edit_pif.py -n 0. UI record: python tests/iter17_ui_setup.py setup|cleanup (prints id; open via [data-testid=edit-{id}] on /prosumator). Number inputs in SldEditor: wait ~2s after sld-editor appears before filling. Retest: PIF survives save-btn; SLD manual edit survives sld-refresh; PUT values 'inf' -> 400.
rca of the issue: Data loss: ModulePage keeps the whole record in `form` and every persist does PUT /data/prosumator/{id} with it. SldEditor and PifPanel write directly via their own endpoints but never update `form`, and update_item only pops opis/snapshot/sld (not pif); cef is a legitimately form-editable field so stale cef overwrites manual values. NaN: float('nan'/'inf') parses successfully; FastAPI's JSON encoder then raises on non-finite floats -> 500 on read.
